title: Safety Officer
shortPitch: Step up as Safety Officer and help lead our safety efforts.

description.overview: We are looking for a capable Safety Officer to join our Safety team and contribute directly to our growth in Health, Safety & Environment (HSE).
topReasonsToJoin: Latest tools, equipment and tech stack provided
Stock options / ESOP for key contributors
Modern office with free lunch and snacks
responsibilities: Carry out core safety activities aligned with company goals and standards.
Carry out collaboration with cross-functional departments, ensuring consistency and accuracy across all deliverables.
Execute documentation and knowledge sharing and provide regular updates to relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate continuous improvement initiatives to support smooth execution and timely delivery.
Maintain reporting and performance tracking, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.
Handle planning and resource allocation in partnership with other departments and external partners.
requirements: At least 1-3 years of hands-on experience relevant to the Safety Officer role.
Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Good command of English (written and spoken)
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
Good stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration
Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

benefits.label: Recognition programs and quarterly awards
Flexible working hours and hybrid option
Social, health & unemployment insurance as per Labor Law

Team building activities and company trips
Holiday and Tet bonus

description.overview: We're hiring a Safety Officer who is passionate about safety and ready to make an impact in a growing Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) organization.
topReasonsToJoin: Hybrid / flexible working hours after probation
Annual company trip and quarterly team-building activities
Fast-growing company with rapid regional expansion
responsibilities: Execute core safety activities aligned with company goals and standards.
Handle quality standards and process compliance, ensuring consistency and accuracy across all deliverables.
Carry out day-to-day operations related to the role and provide regular updates to relevant stakeholders.
Process stakeholder communication and updates to support smooth execution and timely delivery.
Coordinate reporting and performance tracking, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.
Execute collaboration with cross-functional departments in partnership with other departments and external partners.
requirements: At least 1-3 years of hands-on experience relevant to the Safety Officer role.
Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking
Ability to work independently and under pressure
Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

benefits.label: Recognition programs and quarterly awards
Social, health & unemployment insurance as per Labor Law

Premium healthcare package for employee and dependents
16-18 days of paid annual leave
